prompt: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 unusual subjects: INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // creature, structure, geometry that should not be down there FIND      = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // scale vs ROV arm, translucency, motion or stillness SCALE_REF = infer_reference($ SUBJECT)      // manipulator arm, sampling basket in FG for size WATER     = infer_water_column($ SUBJECT)   // particulate density, blue-green absorption SNOW      = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJECT)    // constant drifting flecks lit by lamps LAMPS     = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJECT)   // twin hard lamps, sharp falloff to pure black FLOOR     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJECT)       // silt, disturbed sediment plume, rock OPTIC     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJECT)        // wide, slight fisheye, fixed focus OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJECT)      // depth, temp, heading, lat/long, dive number FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // backscatter glare, focus hunting, chroma noise Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPS) + backscatter(SNOW) MOTION: slow ROV drift → subject enters lamp cone → thruster nudge, silt plume rises → subject reacts or does not → lamps lose it to the dark. Compose: ROV submersible footage, twin lamps with hard falloff to black, marine snow backscatter, telemetry overlay, wide slightly-fisheye lens. Photoreal, 16:9.

promptTranslations.zh: 2x2 网格，16:9，对 4 个不寻常的目标执行此操作：INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // 生物、结构、本不该出现在那里的几何体 FIND      = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // 与 ROV 机械臂的比例、半透明度、运动或静止 SCALE_REF = infer_reference($ SUBJECT)      // 前景中的机械臂、采样篮，用于参照尺寸 WATER     = infer_water_column($ SUBJECT)   // 颗粒密度、蓝绿光吸收 SNOW      = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJECT)    // 被车灯照亮并持续漂移的微粒 LAMPS     = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJECT)   // 双硬光灯，剧烈衰减至纯黑 FLOOR     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJECT)       // 淤泥、扰动的沉积物烟尘、岩石 OPTIC     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJECT)        // 广角、轻微鱼眼、定焦 OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJECT)      // 深度、温度、航向、经纬度、下潜次数 FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // 后向散射眩光、对焦拉风箱、色度噪点 Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPS) + backscatter(SNOW) MOTION: ROV 缓慢漂移 → 目标进入灯光光锥 → 推进器轻微推动，淤泥羽流升起 → 目标产生反应或毫无反应 → 车灯失去目标使其隐入黑暗。构图：ROV 潜水器拍摄画面，带有剧烈衰减至黑色的双灯，海雪后向散射，遥测数据叠加层，广角微鱼眼镜头。逼真照片质感，16:9。

promptTranslations.hi-IN: 2x2 ग्रिड, 16:9, 4 असामान्य विषयों के लिए इसे करें: INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // जीव, संरचना, ज्यामिति जो वहाँ नीचे नहीं होनी चाहिए FIND      = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // ROV आर्म के मुकाबले पैमाना, पारभासीपन, गति या स्थिरता SCALE_REF = infer_reference($ SUBJECT)      // आकार के लिए अग्रभूमि में मैनिपुलेटर आर्म, सैंपलिंग बास्केट WATER     = infer_water_column($ SUBJECT)   // कण घनत्व, नीला-हरा अवशोषण SNOW      = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJECT)    // लैंप द्वारा प्रकाशित निरंतर तैरते समुद्री हिम कण LAMPS     = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJECT)   // जुड़वां हार्ड लैंप, घने काले रंग में तेज गिरावट FLOOR     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJECT)       // गाद, विक्षुब्ध तलछट का गुबार, चट्टान OPTIC     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJECT)        // वाइड, हल्का फिशआई, निश्चित फोकस OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJECT)      // गहराई, तापमान, दिशा, अक्षांश/देशांतर, डाइव संख्या FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // बैकस्कैटर चमक, फोकस हंटिंग, क्रोमा शोर Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPS) + backscatter(SNOW) MOTION: धीमी गति से ROV का बहना → विषय का लैंप कोन में प्रवेश → थ्रस्टर का झटका, गाद का गुबार उठना → विषय की प्रतिक्रिया होना या न होना → लैंप का उसे अंधेरे में खो देना। संयोजन: ROV सबमर्सिबल फुटेज, काले रंग में तीव्र ढलान वाले जुड़वां लैंप, मरीन स्नो बैकस्कैटर, टेलीमेट्री ओवरले, वाइड थोड़ा-फिशआई लेंस। फोटोरिअल, 16:9।
promptTranslations.es-ES: Cuadrícula 2x2, 16:9, haz esto para 4 sujetos inusuales: INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // criatura, estructura, geometría que no debería estar ahí abajo FIND      = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // escala frente al brazo del ROV, translucidez, movimiento o quietud SCALE_REF = infer_reference($ SUBJECT)      // brazo manipulador, cesta de muestreo en primer plano para referencia de tamaño WATER     = infer_water_column($ SUBJECT)   // densidad de partículas, absorción azul-verde SNOW      = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJECT)    // motas constantes a la deriva iluminadas por las lámparas LAMPS     = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJECT)   // lámparas dobles duras, caída brusca a negro puro FLOOR     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJECT)       // limo, pluma de sedimento perturbado, roca OPTIC     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJECT)        // gran angular, ligero ojo de pez, enfoque fijo OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJECT)      // profundidad, temperatura, rumbo, latitud/longitud, número de inmersión FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // resplandor de retrodispersión, búsqueda de enfoque, ruido cromático Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPS) + backscatter(SNOW) MOTION: deriva lenta del ROV → el sujeto entra en el cono de luz de la lámpara → leve empuje de los propulsores, se eleva una pluma de limo → el sujeto reacciona o no reacciona → las lámparas lo pierden en la oscuridad. Composición: metraje de sumergible ROV, lámparas dobles con caída abrupta hacia el negro, retrodispersión de nieve marina, superposición de telemetría, lente gran angular con ligero ojo de pez. Fotorrealista, 16:9.

promptTranslations.de-DE: 2x2-Raster, 16:9, mache dies für 4 ungewöhnliche Subjekte: EINGABE: $ SUBJEKT              // Kreatur, Struktur, Geometrie, die dort unten nicht sein sollte FUND      = infer_subject($ SUBJEKT)        // Maßstab vs. ROV-Arm, Transluzenz, Bewegung oder Stillstand MASS_REF  = infer_reference($ SUBJEKT)      // Manipulatorarm, Probenahmekorb im Vordergrund für die Größe WASSER    = infer_water_column($ SUBJEKT)   // Partikeldichte, blau-grüne Absorption SCHNEE    = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJEKT)    // stetig treibende Flocken, von Lampen beleuchtet LAMPEN    = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJEKT)   // zwei harte Scheinwerfer, scharfer Abfall zu reinem Schwarz BODEN     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJEKT)       // Schlick, aufgewirbelte Sedimentfahne, Fels OPTIK     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJEKT)        // Weitwinkel, leichtes Fischauge, Fixfokus OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJEKT)      // Tiefe, Temp., Kurs, Breitengrad/Längengrad, Tauchgangsnummer FEHLER    = infer_flaws($ SUBJEKT)          // Rückstreublendung, Schärfeziehen, Farbrauschen Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPEN) + backscatter(SCHNEE) BEWEGUNG: langsame ROV-Drift → Subjekt tritt in den Lichtkegel der Lampen ein → Triebwerksschub, Sedimentschleier steigt auf → Subjekt reagiert oder reagiert nicht → Lampen verlieren es an die Dunkelheit. promptTranslations.it-IT: griglia 2x2, 16:9, esegui questo per 4 soggetti insoliti: INPUT: $ SOGGETTO            // creatura, struttura, geometria che non dovrebbe essere laggiù RITROVAMENTO = infer_subject($ SOGGETTO)  // scala rispetto al braccio dell'ROV, traslucenza, movimento o immobilità RIF_SCALA = infer_reference($ SOGGETTO)   // braccio manipolatore, cesto di campionamento in primo piano per la dimensione ACQUA     = infer_water_column($ SOGGETTO)// densità di particolato, assorbimento blu-verde NEVE      = infer_marine_snow($ SOGGETTO) // fiocchi alla deriva costante illuminati dalle lampade LAMPADE   = infer_rov_lighting($ SOGGETTO)// doppie lampade dure, netto decadimento verso il nero puro FONDALE   = infer_seafloor($ SOGGETTO)    // limo, pennacchio di sedimento sollevato, roccia OTTICA    = infer_rov_cam($ SOGGETTO)     // grandangolo, leggero fisheye, messa a fuoco fissa OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SOGGETTO)   // profondità, temp, prua, lat/long, numero immersione DIFETTI   = infer_flaws($ SOGGETTO)       // bagliore da backscatter, caccia del fuoco, rumore cromatico Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPADE) + backscatter(NEVE) MOVIMENTO: deriva lenta dell'ROV → il soggetto entra nel cono della lampada → spinta del propulsore, si solleva un pennacchio di limo → il soggetto reagisce o non reagisce → le lampade lo perdono nel buio. post.originalText:
A prompt template for underwater POV shots. can be used for viral videos if you have the right subject. 

2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 unusual subjects: INPUT: $ SUBJECT              // creature, structure, geometry that should not be down there FIND      = infer_subject($ SUBJECT)        // scale vs ROV arm, translucency, motion or stillness SCALE_REF = infer_reference($ SUBJECT)      // manipulator arm, sampling basket in FG for size WATER     = infer_water_column($ SUBJECT)   // particulate density, blue-green absorption SNOW      = infer_marine_snow($ SUBJECT)    // constant drifting flecks lit by lamps LAMPS     = infer_rov_lighting($ SUBJECT)   // twin hard lamps, sharp falloff to pure black FLOOR     = infer_seafloor($ SUBJECT)       // silt, disturbed sediment plume, rock OPTIC     = infer_rov_cam($ SUBJECT)        // wide, slight fisheye, fixed focus OVERLAY   = infer_telemetry($ SUBJECT)      // depth, temp, heading, lat/long, dive number FLAWS     = infer_flaws($ SUBJECT)          // backscatter glare, focus hunting, chroma noise Φ = lamp_cone(LAMPS) + backscatter(SNOW) MOTION: slow ROV drift → subject enters lamp cone → thruster nudge, silt plume rises → subject reacts or does not → lamps lose it to the dark. Compose: ROV submersible footage, twin lamps with hard falloff to black, marine snow backscatter, telemetry overlay, wide slightly-fisheye lens. Photoreal, 16:9.
